name: aiPHeed five-trigger food-stress risk forecast (E46 I7, defect-corrected)
status: EXPERIMENTAL - FORECASTING ACCEPTANCE NOT MET; enabled only with AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL=e46

information.rule: only data published before the origin 2026-10-01 (E41/E46 protocols)

indicator.name: Food-Stress Risk Probability (exploratory)
indicator.definition: Probability that the province is in concurrent elevated food stress in the target quarter (target T43): SWS self-rated hunger in Balance Luzon above 11.3% (regional) AND the province's PSA food inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E46 defect-corrected five-trigger component model (I7). Exploratory food-stress outcome; not independently verified household food insecurity.
indicator.horizon: Lead 2: issued 2026-10-01 (latest completed quarter 2026-Q3) for 2027-Q1; experimental (E46 I7)
indicator.source: SWS Balance Luzon hunger; PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; NOAA typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA palay/corn and fisheries production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); province-attributed news; official rice-policy orders (as of announcement)
indicator.caveat: Forecasting acceptance (75% Lead-2 accuracy with balanced discrimination) was not met. Exploratory estimate; not an official classification.

scoreTypes.food_stress_risk_probability: Probability that the province is in concurrent elevated food stress in the target quarter (target T43): SWS self-rated hunger in Balance Luzon above 11.3% (regional) AND the province's PSA food inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E46 defect-corrected five-trigger component model (I7). Exploratory food-stress outcome; not independently verified household food insecurity.

attributionMethod: Log-odds effect of moving each trigger group's inputs to their training-set mean, all else fixed (E50). Market / Prices includes the base-effect food and food-minus-headline projections built from PSA CPI; the latest SWS hunger level is reported separately as 'other'. Dashboard percentages are each contributing group's share of the total absolute effect - model attributions, not causal effects or shares of food insecurity.

operationalRules.band: Low if P < 0.33; Watch if 0.33 <= P < 0.67; High if P >= 0.67
operationalRules.alert: Alert candidate when the band is High; staged for administrator confirmation.
operationalRules.municipal: No municipal probability; LGU rankings are relative prioritization.
